iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

RTSP::method
       Returns a method/command from the current RTSP request.

SYNOPSIS
       RTSP::method

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the method/command (for example, DESCRIBE, PLAY) from the current RTSP request.	Syntax

       RTSP::method

	    * Returns the method/command (for example, DESCRIBE, PLAY) from the
	      current RTSP request.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns a method/command from the current RTSP request.

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	rule xxx {
	    when RTSP_REQUEST {
		puts [RTSP::method]
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.4.3 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
